working_plate.description: Corning 96 Well Plate 360 uL Flat (Slot C2)

tube_rack_c1.description: Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with NEST 1.5 mL Snapcap (Samples, Slot C1)

tube_rack_b1.description: Opentrons 24 Tube Rack with NEST 1.5 mL Snapcap (Samples, Slot B1)

reagent_rack.description: Opentrons 10 Tube Rack with NEST 4x50 mL, 6x15 mL Conical (Reagents, Slot A2)

working_reagent_reservoir.description: NEST 12 Well Reservoir 15 mL (Working Reagent, Slot B2)

steps.notes: Volume of Reagent A transferred to reservoir wells A1 and A2 depends on the runtime parameter 'Number of Samples' (columns used); ranges from 2.9 mL for 1 column up to 20.2 mL for 12 columns, split across wells per the working reagent volume table.

Volume of Reagent B transferred depends on columns used (59 uL to 404 uL total); split across reservoir wells A1 and A2 per the working reagent volume table.
Volume of Reagent B transferred depends on columns used (59 uL to 404 uL total); split across reservoir wells A1 and A2 per the working reagent volume table.
Mix volume not specified in protocol; Reagent A and B are combined in reservoir well A1 (and A2 if >6 columns) to form working reagent.

Optional on-deck dilution step (runtime parameter 'Samples diluted on deck'); if Yes, the robot dilutes samples in 1.5 mL tubes in tube_rack_c1/tube_rack_b1 — volumes and diluent not fully specified in protocol.
